# Mycronic vill dubbla omsättningen – Academedia ska betygsättas

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-08-31  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This EFN morning show covers a weak market open. The drivers are renewed tension in the Middle East, with Brent crude above 90 USD, and a hawkish Fed speech that has raised expectations of a US rate hike in September. The main company stories are Mycronic's new 2032-2035 targets (revenue of 20bn SEK at about a 25% margin), which the hosts call less aggressive than they look at roughly 10-11% a year, and AcadeMedia's report without a dividend decision. AcadeMedia's major owner Johan Andersson of Mellby Gård says the company is holding back because its acquisition pipeline is unusually strong. Other topics are the Svevik Industrier IPO, Clas Ohlson's strong run ahead of its report, recoveries in Swedish engineering stocks that now look stretched, analyst rating changes, and the gambling stocks after a US court ruling on prediction markets.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 MYCR — Mycronic | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

New targets imply revenue doubles by 2032-35, but the hosts note that is only ~10-11% a year. Stock slightly down after a strong run-up; CMD this afternoon.

#### Reasoning

The business is doing very well: the old margin target is already exceeded and the new targets raise the bar. The hosts point out the growth rate is not very aggressive and that expectations built up over a long period, so the stock fell despite the higher targets. More news may come from the capital markets day. There is no explicit buy or sell view.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the CMD fails to deliver beyond already-priced expectations
- if the operating margin falls below ~25%

> *"Även om en dubblad omsättning kan låta väldigt aggressivt så om man räknar om det till årstakt så får jag det till en tio 11 procent"*

---

### 🟡 ACAD — AcadeMedia | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Guest (major owner/board member) cites a record M&A pipeline and international expansion, and says Mellby Gård is a buyer rather than a seller. The dividend decision is postponed.

#### Reasoning

This is guest opinion from someone talking his own book. The report was in line and the balance sheet is strong. The pipeline of potential acquisitions has never been larger, with new markets in Poland and England, and the owner aims to be one of the world's largest education companies. Swedish political risk around the election is a headwind, but the owner says few proposals reach parliament. Capital returns (dividend and redemption) are postponed rather than cancelled.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the election produces restrictive policy on private schools
- if acquisitions dilute returns
- if capital returns are cut

> *"Det är klart att i båda de bolagen är vi köpare snarare än säljare."*

---

### 🟠 CLAS-B — Clas Ohlson | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Report Thursday after a ~50% YTD gain. Valuation no longer low at a P/E of 20-22. Watch margins and store-growth pace.

#### Reasoning

The hosts admire the execution: the company beat expectations and raised its targets to a 12% margin and 5% growth. After the big run, though, valuation and expectations on the CEO are higher. Consensus sees the margin plateauing near 13%. The upside depends on further margin expansion and faster store rollout as the consumer improves.

#### Sell Triggers

- if margins stall or fall in Thursday's report
- if store expansion slows
- if guidance disappoints given the elevated P/E

> *"Värderingen är inte låg längre efter den här jätteresan."*

---

### 🟡 GETI-B — Getinge | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Cited analyst view: Nordea downgraded it from buy to hold.

#### Reasoning

This is a cited analyst downgrade (Nordea), not the hosts' own view. The hosts expect it may weigh on the share price.

#### Sell Triggers

- if further analyst downgrades follow

> *"Getinge har fått en negrerad värdering från köp till behåll från Nordea."*

---

### 🟢 ENGCON-B — Engcon | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Cited: DI recommended the stock, and it rose ~5.5% at the open.

#### Reasoning

This is a cited media recommendation (Dagens Industri), not the hosts' opinion. The stock reacted strongly to the buy call.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the recommendation-driven gain fades

> *"Encon, där har DI rekommenderat aktien."*

### 🟢 BONAV-B — Bonava | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Cited: buy recommendation from SB1, and the stock rose.

#### Reasoning

This is a cited analyst buy (SB1), not the hosts' view. Housing developers are still in a weak market according to the guest's comments on small houses.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the housing market recovery stalls

> *"Vi har Bonava och Besqab har också fått, de lyfter båda två, fått en köprekommendation från SB1"*
